en: a man that a person has lived with for a long time and who is recognized (in some countries though not the UK) as a husband, without a formal marriage ceremony
ex: She lives with her common-law husband and their three children.
她与同居丈夫及其三个孩子住在一起。

zh: （未举行结婚仪式的）事实婚姻的男方，事实婚姻的女方
en: a woman that a person has lived with for a long time and who is recognized (in some countries though not the UK) as a wife, without a formal marriage ceremony
a person who does not come from a royal or noble family
ex: It was not acceptable for royalty to marry commoners in those days.
当时，皇室成员嫁给平民是不可接受的。

zh: 公寓楼共有制度（住户共同拥有楼房及公用区域）
en: a system in which each person owns their flat in a building but the building and shared areas are owned by everyone together
usually; very often; by most people
ex: Christopher is commonly known as Kit.
克里斯托弗通常被称为基特。

en: done very often, or existing in many places, and therefore not unusual
ex: This technology is now commonplace in schools.
现在，这种技术在学校中很普遍。

en: (especially in the past) a book into which you copy parts of other books, poems, etc. and add your own comments

zh: 英联邦（由英国和其他大多数曾经隶属于大英帝国的国家组成）
（用于美国肯塔基、马萨诸塞、宾夕法尼亚和弗吉尼亚四州的正式名称中）州
（与美国联系紧密的）自治政区
（用于某些政治上相互有联系的国家集团的名称）联合体
en: an organization consisting of the United Kingdom and other countries, including most of the countries that used to be part of the British Empire
ex: a member of the Commonwealth
英联邦成员国

zh: a public holiday in some parts of the Commonwealth (but not Britain), celebrated every year on the second Monday in March. Before 1958 it was called Empire Day.
en: a public holiday in some parts of the Commonwealth (but not Britain), celebrated every year on the second Monday in March. Before 1958 it was called Empire Day.
sudden noisy and confused activity or excitement
ex: I heard a commotion and went to see what was happening.
我听到一阵喧闹，便去看看发生了什么事情。

en: communications
ex: You'll need to get radio comms set up.
您需要设置无线电通讯。

zh: （尤指居住在一起的人）共享的，共有的，共用的
（集体中）不同群体的，各团体的
en: shared by, or for the use of, a number of people, especially people who live together
ex: a communal kitchen/garden, etc.
共用的厨房、花园等

en: the fact of living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities
